body.p: After every packet the owner accepted. Owns the gate boxes. A separate agent () runs the rubric and re-checks each "done when" and the size budgets. Open items go under "Proposed". Fixed: an undefined pointer offset found by fuzzing (src/xml_input.c), the iXML driver's four error outcomes, EXPath File's four-parameter functions and its clang-tidy findings, Full Text's copy of the XML buffer, two stale record citations; added the fuzz targets ixml_fuzz and full_text_fuzz.
